definitions.gloss: first love; one's first romantic feelings
definitions.explanation: The first experience of romantic love, typically during childhood or adolescence. Carries a strong sense of nostalgia and innocence.

examples.japanese: {初恋|はつこい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{小学校|しょうがっこう}→小学校：01055_shougakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{時|とき}だった。
examples.english: My first love was in elementary school.

examples.japanese: {初恋|はつこい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦クラス→クラス：01084_kurasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{女|おんな}の{子|こ}→女の子：02865_onnanoko⟧だった。
examples.english: My first love was a girl in the same class.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大人|おとな}→大人：02856_otona⟧になって⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{初恋|はつこい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{思|おも}い{出|で}→思い出：00331_omoide⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{忘|わす}れられない→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧。
examples.english: Even as an adult, I can't forget the memories of my first love.

notes:
USAGE:
A universally understood and emotionally resonant concept in Japanese culture. Frequently appears in song lyrics, novels, and films. The word always implies a sweet, nostalgic feeling.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {初恋|はつこい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (one's first love — the person)
- {初恋|はつこい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧ (the object of one's first love)
- {初恋|はつこい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{思|おも}い{出|で}→思い出：00331_omoide⟧ (memories of first love)
- {初恋|はつこい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{実|みの}る→実る：00282_minoru⟧ (first love bears fruit — it works out)
